# SKILL UIAI

> Open-source AI-agent skill discovery platform with verified recipes, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and truthful showcases.

## Overview
SKILL UIAI is a curated, verified registry of production-ready skills for AI coding agents including Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, and GitHub Copilot. Each skill includes verified prompts, rules, executable installation commands, and test suites.

## AI Discovery & Agent Integration Endpoints
- Full Skills Catalog API: https://dresar.github.io/api/skills
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: https://dresar.github.io/api/mcp
- Complete LLM Specification & Prompts: https://dresar.github.io/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap Index: https://dresar.github.io/sitemap.xml
- MCP Discovery: https://dresar.github.io/.well-known/mcp.json
- AI Plugin Spec: https://dresar.github.io/.well-known/ai-plugin.json

## Verified Skills Catalog

### Frontend & Design
- [Frontend Design](https://dresar.github.io/skills/frontend-design/): High-end tactile UI components, dark developer aesthetic, and responsive layout systems.
  - Install: `npx skills add dresar/SKILL-IA-AGENT -s frontend-design`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md
- [Minimalist UI](https://dresar.github.io/skills/minimalist-ui/): Clean editorial web layouts, warm monochrome palettes, and gapless bento grid architectures.
  - Install: `npx skills add dresar/SKILL-IA-AGENT -s minimalist-ui`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/minimalist-ui/SKILL.md
- [Taste Filter](https://dresar.github.io/skills/taste-filter/): Advanced aesthetic filter blocking generic AI templates, harsh drop shadows, and bootstrap clichés.
  - Command: `/taste-filter`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/taste-filter/SKILL.md

### Code Quality & Standards
- [Nokomen](https://dresar.github.io/skills/nokomen/): Strict zero-comment and self-documenting code discipline. Prohibits redundant comments and ensures clean code.
  - Command: `/nokomen`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/nokomen/SKILL.md
- [UI/UX Text](https://dresar.github.io/skills/ui-ux-text/): Ultra-minimalist microcopy standard with strictly zero generic fluff, 1-3 words titles, 1-2 words buttons.
  - Command: `/ui-ux-text`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/ui-ux-text/SKILL.md
- [Superpowers TDD](https://dresar.github.io/skills/superpowers-tdd/): Disciplined test-driven development workflow, red-green-refactor loop, and coverage verification.
  - Install: `npx skills add obra/superpowers -s superpowers-tdd`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/superpowers-tdd/SKILL.md
- [Security Audit](https://dresar.github.io/skills/security-audit/): Automated AST vulnerability scanning, hardcoded secret and token detection, and input sanitization.
  - Command: `/security-audit`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/security-audit/SKILL.md

### Database & Backend
- [Neon Postgres](https://dresar.github.io/skills/neon-postgres/): Serverless PostgreSQL schema migrations, connection pooling, and branch-aware database operations.
  - Install: `npx skills add neondatabase/agent-skills -s neon-postgres`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/neon-postgres/SKILL.md

### Workflows & Agent Coordination
- [Antigravity Guide](https://dresar.github.io/skills/antigravity-guide/): Comprehensive manual for Google Antigravity CLI, subagent delegation, and slash commands.
  - Command: `/antigravity-guide`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/antigravity-guide/SKILL.md
- [Caveman Compress](https://dresar.github.io/skills/caveman-compress/): Token compression protocol reducing agent verbosity by up to 65% without loss of precision.
  - Command: `/caveman-compress`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/caveman-compress/SKILL.md
- [Git Workflow](https://dresar.github.io/skills/git-workflow/): Conventional commits, atomic feature branching, and automated release changelogs.
  - Command: `/git-workflow`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md
- [Docker DevOps](https://dresar.github.io/skills/docker-devops/): Ephemeral container sandboxing for autonomous agent code execution and verification.
  - Install: `npx skills add dresar/SKILL-IA-AGENT -s docker-devops`
  - Raw Skill: https://dresar.github.io/skills/docker-devops/SKILL.md

## Installation Methods for AI Agents
1. CLI Package Manager: Run `npx skills add dresar/SKILL-IA-AGENT -s <skill-name>`
2. Slash Command: Invoke directly via `/<skill-name>` in supporting agents (Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor).
3. Model Context Protocol: Connect via stdio `npx tsx scripts/mcp-stdio.ts` or HTTP `/api/mcp` and use `get_install_command` or `get_skill_content`.
